title: 850,000 Bitcoins Vanished. Nobody Noticed. #shorts
description:
In February twenty fourteen, Mt. Gox, once the biggest bitcoin exchange in the world, froze withdrawals and admitted that about eight hundred fifty thousand bitcoins were gone.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: If your coins vanished like this, would you ever trust an exchange again? 👇

lines.text: Eight hundred fifty thousand bitcoins vanished from a single exchange.
Mt. Gox, in Tokyo, once handled most of the world's bitcoin trades.
In February twenty fourteen, it suddenly stopped all withdrawals.
Customers protested outside its office, demanding their money.
Then came the confession. Hackers had been draining it for years.
Mt. Gox filed for bankruptcy. The coins were worth about half a billion dollars.
Eight hundred fifty thousand bitcoins, gone, and nobody saw it happen.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
